title: Crowley's Lam entity

tellings.quote: And and Crowley's another guy who had an alien being sort of seemed to show up and

plain: Michels says that the English occultist Aleister Crowley was another person to whom an alien-seeming being "sort of seemed to show up", a figure known as Lam. He mentions it briefly himself, without a source, while talking with a guest about contact with strange beings, placing Crowley among people who claimed meetings with such entities.
